# actions

End, Resume and Remove a session, the pane snapshot for dead sessions, confirm dialogs.

- Spec: `docs/features/actions/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/actions/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/sessions*.go
web: web/src/features/actions.ts
web: web/src/render/confirm.ts
web: web/src/render/dead*.ts
web: web/src/render/actionerror*.ts
e2e: web/e2e/actions.spec.ts
```

## Protocol

- `sessions.end` — `POST /api/sessions/{id}/end`
- `sessions.resume` — `POST /api/sessions/{id}/resume`
- `sessions.remove` — `DELETE /api/sessions/{id}`
- `sessions.pane` — `GET /api/sessions/{id}/pane`
- `ws.session-removed` — `sessionRemoved`

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/actions-kill-is-idempotent` — A tmux session that is already gone counts as a successful kill; only a genuine tmux failure blocks End and Remove. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: actions, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/actions-kill-is-idempotent.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-pane-snapshot-display-only` — The daemon captures each live pane on every liveness tick and serves the last capture for a dead session, dimmed under an ended cap; display only. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus) → `docs/adr/actions-pane-snapshot-display-only.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-remove-allowed-on-live-session` — Remove is allowed on a live session; it ends the session first and its dialog says so, then deletes the row and broadcasts sessionRemoved. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/actions-remove-allowed-on-live-session.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-serialized-per-session` — Launch, Resume, End and Remove hold a per-session-id lock, and the shell registry's global mutex becomes per-id. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: actions, lifecycle, surfaces) → `docs/adr/actions-serialized-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-reconcile-converges-with-the-socket` — Reconcile decides row ownership from tmux list-sessions, repairs tmux_target from tmux, and never deletes a row whose pane is alive. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-reconcile-converges-with-the-socket.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-resume-rebinds-existing-session` — Resuming a dead session keeps the Muster row and its title and rebinds it to the new pane, matched on the unchanged Claude session_id. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-resume-rebinds-existing-session.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-lifetime-until-exit-remove-or-reconcile` — A shell outlives End and view switches and can open on a dead session; it dies on exit, Remove or reconcile, which kills every shell rather than adopting. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-lifetime-until-exit-remove-or-reconcile.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-danger-tokens-not-rose` — Destructive actions use a danger token family; rose stays reserved for the Failed state rather than the rule being amended. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: theme, actions) → `docs/adr/theme-danger-tokens-not-rose.md`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/resume-keeps-session-identity` — claude --resume <id> emits SessionStart{source:"resume"} with the original session_id and transcript_path. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.270; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/facts/resume-keeps-session-identity.md`

## Lessons

- `kb:lesson/shared-class-css-hid-resume-button` — A Minor fix gave .acts-row opacity 0 until hover; the dead surface reused the class, Resume vanished, and toBeVisible() passed over a Critical. (active, 2026-08-27; features: actions) → `docs/lessons/shared-class-css-hid-resume-button.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/lifecycle-ended-rows-swept-next-start` — On start, rows already ended are deleted and live rows whose pane is gone are marked ended and kept, so every death gets one resume chance. (superseded, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-ended-rows-swept-next-start.md`
